name: @cw-code/desktop

scripts.dist: bun --filter @cw-code/ui build && bun --filter @cw-code/server compile && bun --bun electron-vite build && bun --bun electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: bun --filter @cw-code/ui build && bun --filter @cw-code/server compile && bun --bun electron-vite build && bun --bun electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: bun --filter @cw-code/ui build && bun --filter @cw-code/server compile && bun --bun electron-vite build && bun --bun electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never

author: cw-code
description: A desktop workspace for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
